## Context / Problem
Entering the review-bot ASGI lifespan from an ordinary test started the real backfill reconciler and snapshot janitor, while shutdown inherited the production 1200-second queue-drain default. The idiomatic TestClient lifespan path could therefore turn a unit test into a long-running background sweep or hang. The production behavior is intentional and unchanged: src/rebar/review_bot/config.py defines DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS = 1200, and shutdown_drain_seconds() accepts a positive SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS override.

## Delivered Approach
- tests/conftest.py now uses the root autouse fixture _bound_review_bot_shutdown_drain to set SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS=1.0 for every test and registers the real_reconcile_loop marker.
- tests/unit/test_review_bot.py now uses the module-autouse fixture _safe_review_bot_lifespan_defaults to replace reconcile.reconcile_loop and rebar._snapshot.start_background_janitor during ordinary tests. Marked tests bypass only the reconciler replacement; the unrelated filesystem janitor remains stubbed.
- test_lifespan_is_safe_by_default_without_per_test_stubs exercises TestClient against the real application lifespan without local reconciler or janitor setup and asserts the exact 1.0-second test drain.
- test_lifespan_can_opt_into_the_real_reconcile_loop uses the marker plus an observable reconcile_once fake to prove the production reconcile_loop remains available.
- The five previously duplicated or specialized string-patch sites within tests/unit/test_review_bot.py were classified: identical setup was removed, test_lifespan_starts_and_stops_snapshot_janitor retains its observable janitor fake, and test_lifespan_cancel_await_is_bounded_for_a_task_slow_to_cancel retains its slow-reconciler fault injection.
- The repo-wide string census also found tests/unit/test_review_bot_retrigger.py. Its test-specific reconcile_loop and worker replacements are intentionally retained because they model a queued manual-rerun shutdown path outside the module fixture's scope; its 0.1-second override keeps that deliberate non-task-done queue control fast while proving local overrides take precedence.
- No production files changed.

## Verification
- RED: test_lifespan_is_safe_by_default_without_per_test_stubs initially observed 1200.0 instead of the required test-only 1.0.
- Focused lifespan contracts passed 8 tests; tests/unit/test_review_bot.py passed 86 tests.
- A defect-seeded mutation restoring 1200.0 failed the RED oracle.
- make check passed.
- The CI-equivalent macOS xdist lane passed 11,382 tests with 19 expected skips.
- Local review-code passed with 0 blocking and 0 advisory.
- Gerrit change 1526 patchset 2 received LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 with zero unresolved comments, was submitted, and is mirrored on origin/main at 4c89592d88c7158d7ba327be2baf81583c3e4adb.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Every pytest test receives the exact SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS=1.0 baseline through _bound_review_bot_shutdown_drain; verified by test_lifespan_is_safe_by_default_without_per_test_stubs and the focused review-bot tests.
- [x] The production default remains exactly 1200 seconds; verified by DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS and test_reviewbot_stop_grace_period_covers_an_in_flight_store_write.
- [x] A test-local SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS=0.1 override wins over the suite baseline; verified by test_lifespan_drain_is_bounded.
- [x] Entering the review-bot lifespan is safe by default with no per-test reconciler or janitor stubs; verified by test_lifespan_is_safe_by_default_without_per_test_stubs.
- [x] All five existing string-referenced stub sites in tests/unit/test_review_bot.py are classified and the additional purpose-specific retrigger-module override is explicitly retained; verified by the focused tests and repo-wide string census.
- [x] A marked test explicitly runs the real production reconcile_loop; verified by test_lifespan_can_opt_into_the_real_reconcile_loop observing reconcile_once during lifespan startup.
- [x] The worktree passed make check and the CI-equivalent test lane; Gerrit recorded LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 before submission.
